description: 墙壁粘贴挂钩，带背板和螺丝孔
description_en: Wall-mounted hook with backplate and screw holes
code:
import cadquery as cq

# === 参数 ===
plate_w = 30     # 背板宽 (mm)
plate_h = 60     # 背板高 (mm)
plate_t = 4      # 背板厚 (mm)
hook_len = 30    # 挂钩前伸 (mm)
hook_d = 8       # 挂钩直径 (mm)
screw_d = 4      # 螺丝孔直径 (mm)

# === 背板 (立在 XZ 平面，贴墙) ===
result = cq.Workplane("XY").box(plate_w, plate_t, plate_h, centered=(True, True, False))

# === 挂钩臂 (从底部前伸再上翘，少支撑) ===
arm = cq.Workplane("XY").box(hook_d, hook_len, hook_d, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, plate_t/2 + hook_len/2, hook_d/2))
tip = cq.Workplane("XY").box(hook_d, hook_d, hook_d*2, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, plate_t/2 + hook_len, hook_d))
result = result.union(arm).union(tip)

# === 螺丝孔 (上下各一) ===
result = (
    result.faces("<Y").workplane(centerOption="CenterOfBoundBox")
    .pushPoints([(0, plate_h/2 - 8), (0, -plate_h/2 + 8)])
    .hole(screw_d)
)
result = result.edges("|X").fillet(1.5)

show_object(result)
